value.rationale: The two sources are the extremal nine-point homotopically trivial noncontractible finite spaces. Computing the entire circle-valued mapping-space core is a natural invariant and is strictly stronger than counting homotopy classes: all maps are homotopic, yet the mapping space retains a circle. This gives a concrete structural separation between the homotopy set and the function-space homotopy type.
